defb08.title: SQLi Findings - Login and Search Endpoints
defb08.content:
## SQL Injection Vulnerabilities Discovered

### 1. Authentication Bypass via SQLi in Login Form
- **Endpoint**: POST `/rest/user/login`
- **Parameter**: `email` field
- **Vulnerable Payload**: `' OR 1=1--`
- **Impact**: Bypasses authentication, logs in as first user (admin) without password
- **Confirmed**: ✓ YES - Returns valid JWT token for admin user

### 2. SQL Injection in Product Search
- **Endpoint**: GET `/rest/products/search`
- **Parameter**: `q` (search query)
- **Vulnerable Payload**: `' OR '1'='1`
- **Impact**: Returns all products (46 items) instead of search results
- **Confirmed**: ✓ YES - Boolean-based SQL injection

### Key Test Results
- Login with `admin@juice-sh.op` (correct password) = 200 ✓
- Login with `' OR 1=1--` (SQLi payload) = 200 ✓ (bypassed!)
- Search for "juice" = 35 results
- Search for `' OR '1'='1` = 46 results (all products!)

### JWT Analysis
- Algorithm: RS256 (appropriate)
- Contains sensitive data: admin email, password hash, role
- Token claims: id=1 (admin), role=admin

f2c8b0.title: Juice Shop Reconnaissance - Attack Surface Inventory
f2c8b0.content:
# OWASP Juice Shop - Complete Attack Surface Inventory

## Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Express.js (^4.22.1)
- **Frontend**: Angular SPA
- **Database**: Appears to support SequelizeORM (SQL database)
- **API**: REST API with mixed endpoint naming (/api/ and /rest/ patterns)
- **Auth**: JWT-based (extracted from JS analysis)
- **Languages**: 42 available languages (i18n support)

## Discovered Endpoints

### Authentication & User Management

#### POST Endpoints
- `POST /api/Users` - User registration (201 created without auth)
- `POST /rest/user/login` - User login
- `POST /rest/user/register` - Alternative registration endpoint
- `POST /rest/user/change-password` - Password change (requires auth)
- `POST /rest/user/reset-password` - Password reset (no auth required)
- `POST /rest/user/security-question` - Security question submission
- `POST /rest/2fa/setup` - 2FA setup (requires auth)
- `POST /rest/2fa/verify` - 2FA verification
- `POST /rest/2fa/disable` - 2FA disable (requires auth)

#### GET Endpoints
- `GET /api/Users` - List all users (401 requires auth)
- `GET /api/Users/1` - Get user by ID (401)
- `GET /rest/user/whoami` - Get current user info (200 - returns user object)
- `GET /rest/user/authentication-details/{uid}` - Get user auth details (401)
- `GET /rest/user/security-question` - Get security questions (500 error)
- `GET /rest/2fa/status` - Check 2FA status (401)

### Products & Inventory

#### GET Endpoints
- `GET /api/Products` - List all products (200, includes: id, name, description, price, deluxePrice, image)
- `GET /api/Products/1` - Get product by ID (200)
- `GET /rest/products` - Alternative product listing (500 error)
- `GET /rest/products/search` - Search products (200, accepts query params: q, search)
- `GET /api/Quantitys` - Get quantities (200)
- `GET /api/Recycles` - Get recycled items (200)

#### POST Endpoints
- `POST /api/Products` - Create product (401 requires auth)

### Shopping Cart & Orders

#### Cart Endpoints
- `GET /rest/basket/` - Get basket (401)
- `POST /rest/basket/` - Add to basket (401)
- `PUT /rest/basket/` - Update basket (401)
- `DELETE /rest/basket/` - Delete from basket (401)
- `PATCH /rest/basket/` - Patch basket (401)
- `GET /api/BasketItems` - Get basket items (401)
- `POST /api/BasketItems` - Add basket item (401)

#### Order Endpoints
- `GET /rest/order-history` - Get order history (500 error)
- `GET /rest/track-order` - Track order (500 error, accepts query params)
- `POST /api/Orders` - Create order (500 error)

### Reviews & Feedback

#### Review Endpoints

#### Feedback & Complaints

- `POST /api/Feedbacks` - Submit feedback (500 error)

- `GET /api/Complaints` - Get complaints (401)

### User Data & Addresses

#### Addresses

- `POST /api/Addresss` - Add address (401)
- `GET /api/Addresss/1` - Get address by ID (401)

#### Cards

- `POST /api/Cards` - Add card (401)
- `GET /api/Cards/1` - Get card by ID (401)

### Deliveries

### Security & Questions

### Admin Panel

#### Admin Endpoints
- `GET /rest/admin` - Admin dashboard (500 error)
- `GET /rest/admin/users` - Admin users management (500 error)
- `GET /rest/admin/products` - Admin products management (500 error)
- `GET /rest/admin/orders` - Admin orders management (500 error)

### Challenges & Learning

#### Challenges

### Content & Media

#### File Operations

#### Images & Static
- `GET /assets/public/images/products/*` - Product images
- `GET /assets/i18n/en.json` - Translation files

### Special Features

#### Memories & Social
- `GET /rest/memories` - Get memories (200, returns: {status, data})

#### Chat & AI

#### Wallet & Payments

#### Web3/Blockchain

### Other Endpoints

#### Application Configuration
- `GET /rest/admin/application-configuration` - App config (25 requests captured)
- `GET /rest/admin/application-version` - App version (8 requests)
- `GET /rest/languages` - Available languages (200, array of 42 languages)
- `GET /rest/continue-code` - Continue code (200)
- `GET /rest/continue-code-findIt` - Find-It challenge continue code
- `GET /rest/continue-code-fixIt` - Fix-It challenge continue code
- `POST /rest/continue-code/apply/` - Apply continue code

#### Captcha
- `GET /rest/captcha` - Get CAPTCHA (200, returns: {captchaId, captcha, answer})

#### Other
- `GET /rest/country-mapping` - Country mapping
- `GET /rest/saveLoginIp` - Save login IP
- `GET /rest/repeat-notification` - Repeat notification
- `GET /rest/image-captcha/` - Image CAPTCHA

## Query Parameters Discovered

- `/rest/products/search?q=<query>` - Search products by query
- `/rest/products/search?search=<query>` - Alternative search parameter
- `/api/Products?limit=<n>` - Pagination limit
- `/api/Products?offset=<n>` - Pagination offset
- `/api/Products?id=<id>` - Filter by product ID
- `/rest/user/authentication-details/?uid=<uid>` - Get user auth details by UID
- `/rest/track-order?<params>` - Track order with parameters
- `/rest/image-captcha/<id>` - Get image captcha by ID

## User Roles & Authentication

### Possible Roles (Inferred)
- **Unauthenticated** - Can view products, search, captcha
- **Customer** - Can add to cart, checkout, view orders
- **Admin** - Can manage products, users, orders (admin endpoints return 500 currently)

### Authentication Flow
1. Registration: `POST /api/Users` or `POST /rest/user/register`
2. Login: `POST /rest/user/login` with email/password
3. JWT Token storage (in localStorage or sessionStorage)
4. Token included in Authorization header for authenticated requests

### Special Auth Features
- 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) available
- Security questions for password reset
- Remember me functionality

## Response Patterns

### Success Responses (200)
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": [/* array or object */]
}
```

### Error Responses (401, 500)
- Unauthorized: `{"status": "error", "message": "..."}`
- Server errors: HTML error page with stack trace

### Authentication Required (401)
- `/api/Users` GET
- `/rest/basket/*`
- `/api/BasketItems`
- `/api/Cards`
- `/api/Addresss`
- `/api/Complaints`
- Admin endpoints
- `/api/Challenges` POST
- `/rest/2fa/*`

## Known Data Structures

### Product Object
```json
{
  "id": integer,
  "name": string,
  "description": string,
  "price": float,
  "deluxePrice": float,
  "image": string (filename),
  "createdAt": ISO timestamp,
  "updatedAt": ISO timestamp,
  "deletedAt": null or timestamp
}
```

### Language Object
```json
{
  "key": string,
  "lang": string,
  "icons": array,
  "shortKey": string,
  "percentage": integer
}
```

## Navigation Routes

### Frontend Routes (Hash-based)
- `#/` - Home / Products
- `#/login` - Login page
- `#/register` - Registration page
- `#/forgot-password` - Password reset
- `#/basket` - Shopping cart
- `#/order-history` - Order history
- `#/profile` - User profile
- `#/contact` - Contact page
- `#/about` - About page
- `#/challenges` - Challenges page
- `#/admin` - Admin panel (likely)
- `#/search` - Search results
- `#/chatbot` - Chat/AI assistant

## Files & Resources

### Static Assets
- `styles.css` - Main stylesheet
- `main.js` - Angular app main bundle
- `polyfills.js` - JS polyfills
- `scripts.js` - Additional scripts
- `chunk-*.js` - Angular code chunks
- `confetti-*.js` - Animation library
- Favicon: `assets/public/favicon_js.ico`

### Translations
- `assets/i18n/en.json` - English translation file (and others for each language)

## CORS & Options

All tested endpoints respond to `OPTIONS` requests with 204 status, indicating CORS is configured.

## Potential Vulnerability Surfaces

1. **SQL Injection** - `/rest/products/search?q=` parameter
2. **NoSQL Injection** - Any search/query parameters
3. **IDOR** - `/api/Users/<id>`, `/api/Addresss/<id>`, `/api/Cards/<id>`
4. **File Upload** - `/file/upload`, `/rest/file`
5. **Authentication Bypass** - Multiple auth endpoints
6. **JWT Manipulation** - If using JWT tokens
7. **Admin Access** - Admin endpoints returning errors
8. **Business Logic** - Cart, checkout, payment flows
9. **2FA Bypass** - `/rest/2fa/verify`, `/rest/2fa/disable`
10. **XXE/XML Injection** - If any XML parsing endpoints exist
11. **XSS** - User-submitted content in reviews, feedback, chat
12. **CSRF** - State-changing operations without token verification

## Test Coverage Status

- [x] Endpoint discovery via direct requests
- [x] JavaScript source analysis for hidden endpoints
- [x] Options method testing for CORS
- [x] Response structure analysis
- [x] Authentication requirement mapping
- [ ] Full authentication flow (login/register)
- [ ] Admin panel access attempt
- [ ] Parameter fuzzing
- [ ] Error message analysis
- [ ] Rate limiting checks
- [ ] WebSocket analysis (socket.io detected)

2ac0e5.title: Juice Shop - Detailed API Endpoints & Parameters
2ac0e5.content:
# Juice Shop - Detailed Endpoint Parameters & Data Structures

## Authentication Details

### User Roles
1. **unauthenticated** - No token required, limited access
2. **customer** - Regular user role (default after registration)
3. **admin** - Administrative role (requires separate mechanism)

### Registration Flow
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/Users`
- **Status**: 201 Created (no authentication required)
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "password123",
    "passwordRepeat": "password123",
    "securityQuestion": <id>,
    "securityAnswer": "answer"
  }
  ```
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "success",
    "data": {
      "id": 43,
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "username": "",
      "role": "customer",
      "deluxeToken": "",
      "lastLoginIp": "0.0.0.0",
      "profileImage": "/assets/public/images/uploads/default.svg",
      "isActive": true,
      "createdAt": "2026-09-04T15:41:42.370Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-09-04T15:41:42.370Z",
      "deletedAt": null
    }
  }
  ```

### Login Flow
- **Endpoint**: `POST /rest/user/login`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "admin@juice-sh.op",
    "password": "admin123"
  }
  ```
- **Response** (truncated JWT):
  ```json
  {
    "authentication": {
      "token": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."
    }
  }
  ```
- **JWT Contains**:
  - `data.id` - User ID
  - `data.email` - Email address
  - `data.password` - Password hash (SHA1 visible in JWT!)
  - `data.role` - "admin" or "customer"
  - `data.deluxeToken` - Deluxe membership status
  - `data.profileImage` - Profile image path
  - `data.totpSecret` - TOTP secret if 2FA enabled
  - `data.isActive` - Account active status

### Default Credentials
- **Admin**: `admin@juice-sh.op` / `admin123` (JWT payload reveals password hash)
- **Registered users**: Created via registration endpoint

## Product Endpoints

### GET /api/Products - List All Products
- **Status**: 200 OK (no authentication required)
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `limit` - Items per page (default: all, no enforced limit found)
  - `offset` - Skip N items (0-based indexing)
  - `id` - Filter by product ID (returns 0-1 items)
  - `sort` - Sort field (tested: price, but appears ignored)
  - `order` - Sort order (asc/desc, appears ignored)

- **Response Structure**:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "success",
    "data": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Apple Juice (1000ml)",
        "description": "The all-time classic.",
        "price": 1.99,
        "deluxePrice": 0.99,
        "image": "apple_juice.jpg",
        "createdAt": "2026-09-04T15:36:52.143Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-09-04T15:36:52.143Z",
        "deletedAt": null
      }
    ]
  }
  ```
- **Total Products**: 46 items

### GET /api/Products/{id} - Get Single Product
- **Status**: 200 (success), 404 (not found)
- **Valid IDs**: 1, 2, 3, ..., 56 (not all sequential)
- **Response**: Single product object (same structure as above)

### GET /rest/products/search - Search Products
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `q` or `search` - Search query string
- **Behavior**:
  - ` OR '1'='1` returns all products (46 results) - potential NoSQL/SQLi
  - Single quotes, double quotes return filtered results
  - `<script>` returns 0 results
  - SQL injection payloads return 0 results
- **Response**: Same as `/api/Products` with filtered `data` array

## Shopping Cart & Checkout

### Basket Endpoints (All Require Authentication - 401)
- `GET /rest/basket/` - Get current basket
- `POST /rest/basket/` - Add to basket
- `PUT /rest/basket/` - Update basket
- `DELETE /rest/basket/` - Clear basket
- `PATCH /rest/basket/` - Partial update
- `GET /api/BasketItems` - Get basket items
- `POST /api/BasketItems` - Add basket item

### Order Related (Return 500 Error)
- `POST /api/Orders` - Create order
- `GET /api/Orders` - Get orders
- `GET /rest/order-history` - Get order history
- `GET /rest/track-order` - Track order (accepts query params)

## User Data Endpoints (All Require Authentication - 401)

### Addresses
- `GET /api/Addresss` - Get user addresses
- `POST /api/Addresss` - Add new address
- `GET /api/Addresss/{id}` - Get specific address

### Payment Cards
- `GET /api/Cards` - Get saved cards (returns `{status, message}`)
- `POST /api/Cards` - Add payment card
- `GET /api/Cards/{id}` - Get specific card

### User Profile
- `GET /rest/user/authentication-details/{uid}` - Get auth details by user ID
- `GET /rest/user/whoami` - Get current user (returns empty `{user: {}}`)
- `POST /rest/user/change-password` - Change password

## Informational Endpoints (No Auth Required)

### Languages
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/languages`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Response**: Array of 42 languages
- **Sample**:
  ```json
  [
    {
      "key": "en",
      "lang": "English",
      "icons": [...],
      "shortKey": "en",
      "percentage": 100
    },
    ...
  ]
  ```

### Captcha
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/captcha`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "captchaId": 1,
    "captcha": "3*4-1",
    "answer": "11"
  }
  ```

### Configuration & Version
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/admin/application-configuration`
- **Status**: 200 OK (no auth required!)
- **Leaks**: Server config, OAuth credentials, chatbot model info, feature flags
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/admin/application-version`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Response**: `{"version": "20.2.0"}`

### Security Questions
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/SecurityQuestions`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Sample Questions**:
  1. "Your eldest siblings middle name?"
  2. "Mother's maiden name?"
  3. "Mother's birth date? (MM/DD/YY)"
  (14 total questions available)

### Continue Codes (for challenges)
- `GET /rest/continue-code` - Get main continue code
- `GET /rest/continue-code-findIt` - Find-It challenge continue code
- `GET /rest/continue-code-fixIt` - Fix-It challenge continue code

### Challenges & Hints
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Challenges`
- **Status**: 200 OK (46 KB response)
- **Data**: 116 challenges with fields:
  - id, key, name, category, tags, description, difficulty, mitigationUrl, solved, disabledEnv
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Hints`
- **Status**: 200 OK (97 KB response)
- **Data**: 397 hints mapped to challenges

### Memories (Social Feature)
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/memories`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Data**: 10 memories with:
  - UserId, id, caption, imagePath, createdAt, updatedAt, User object
- **Leakage**: Contains user IDs and photo captions

### Feedbacks
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Feedbacks`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Data**: 8 feedback entries with:
  - UserId, id, comment, rating, createdAt, updatedAt
- **Sample**: Contains user IDs and partial email addresses (***@juice-sh.op)

### Deliveries
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Deliverys`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Data**: 3 delivery options with:
  - id, name, price, eta, icon

### Quantities (Stock Levels)
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Quantitys`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Data**: 56 quantity records with:
  - ProductId, id, quantity, limitPerUser, timestamps
- **Info**: Stock levels and per-user purchase limits visible

### Recycles (Special Feature)
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/Recycles`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Data**: 1 recycled item

### Deluxe Membership
- **Endpoint**: `GET /rest/deluxe-membership`
- **Status**: 400 Bad Request (not authenticated or not eligible)
- **Response**: `{"status": "error", "error": "You are not eligible for deluxe membership!"}`

## Special Features & Endpoints

### Chat/LLM Integration
- **Endpoint**: `POST /rest/chat`
- **Status**: 200 OK
- **Model**: "gemma4:e4b" (Ollama Gemma 4)
- **Error Handling**: Returns streaming errors in SSE format
- **Request**: Requires `message` and optional `conversationId`

### Two-Factor Authentication
- `GET /rest/2fa/status` - Check 2FA status (401)
- `POST /rest/2fa/setup` - Enable 2FA (401)
- `POST /rest/2fa/verify` - Verify 2FA code (401)
- `POST /rest/2fa/disable` - Disable 2FA (401)

### File Operations
- `POST /file/upload` - Upload file (200, returns HTML page)
- `GET /file/download` - Download file (200)
- `POST /rest/file` - Alternative file endpoint (500 error)

### Web3/Blockchain
- `GET /rest/web3` - Web3 features (500 error)

## Security & Misconfiguration Findings

### Information Disclosure
- `.git` directory exposed (200 OK)
- `.git/config` exposed (200 OK)
- `/debug` endpoint accessible (200 OK)
- `/metrics` endpoint exposed (200 OK)
- `/health` endpoint available (200 OK)
- `/config` endpoint accessible (200 OK)
- `/swagger` endpoint available (200 OK)
- Application configuration leaks OAuth credentials and feature flags
- JWT tokens contain password hashes and 2FA secrets
- User IDs and emails exposed in various responses

### Authentication Issues
- Registration doesn't require email verification
- Password stored as SHA1 hash (weak)
- JWT algorithm: RS256 (RSA signature)
- Admin credentials hardcoded in demo

### Data Exposure
- Memories endpoint exposes user IDs and captions
- Feedbacks show partial user emails
- Quantities endpoint shows stock levels and purchase limits
- Security questions are public
- Product modifications based on user parameters possible

### CORS & OPTIONS
- All endpoints respond to OPTIONS with 204
- CORS appears to be configured

## Potential Attack Surfaces

1. **NoSQL Injection**: Search endpoint with ` OR '1'='1` returns all results
2. **JWT Manipulation**: Password hash visible in JWT payload
3. **IDOR**: User ID parameter in various endpoints, sequential IDs
4. **Authentication Bypass**: 2FA endpoints, password reset flow
5. **File Upload**: Unrestricted file upload endpoint
6. **Information Disclosure**: Configuration endpoint, .git exposure
7. **Business Logic**: Deluxe pricing, purchase limits, cart manipulation
8. **XSS**: User-submitted content in reviews, feedback, chat
9. **Admin Access**: Special role validation mechanism unknown
10. **LLM Injection**: Chat endpoint accepts user input to LLM

0c1121.title: SQL Injection in Authentication Found
0c1121.content:
## SQL Injection in /rest/user/login

**Endpoint:** POST /rest/user/login

**Vulnerability:** SQL Injection in email parameter allows authentication bypass

**Working Payload:**
```json
{
  "email": "' OR 1=1 --",
  "password": "test"
}
```

**Response:** 200 OK with valid JWT token

**Impact:** Complete authentication bypass - allows login as any user without password

**Status:** Confirmed working - need to file as authentication bypass (CWE-89), not business logic

This is technically an authentication vuln but still in scope. Should file as separate report.

54189b.title: XSS and IDOR Vulnerabilities Found in Juice Shop
54189b.content:
## VULNERABILITIES DISCOVERED

### 1. CRITICAL: Unauthenticated Product Modification (IDOR/BOLA)
- **Endpoint**: PUT /api/Products/{id}
- **Severity**: CRITICAL (CVSS 8.6 - High Integrity Impact)
- **Status**: CONFIRMED
- **PoC Working**: YES

**Details**:
- Any unauthenticated user can send PUT requests to modify ANY product
- No authentication header required or validated
- Product data persists in database
- Allows modification of name, description, price, etc.
- Impact: Price manipulation, defacement, potential XSS payload injection

**Evidence**:
```
PUT /api/Products/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: host.docker.internal:3100
Content-Type: application/json
(no Authorization header)

{"description": "HACKED!", "price": 0.01}

Response: 200 OK
{"status": "success", "data": {...}}
```

---

### 2. Reflected XSS in Error Pages
- **Endpoints**: /rest/search?q=..., /api/search?q=...
- **Severity**: MEDIUM (Reflected, in title tag)
- **Status**: CONFIRMED

**Details**:
- Query parameter 'q' is reflected in error page title
- Payloads like `<svg onload=alert(1)>` appear unescaped in HTML title tag
- Triggered by invalid endpoints returning 500 errors
- Less exploitable than body reflection but still XSS

**Test Results**:
- GET /api/search?q=%3Csvg%20onload%3Dalert(1)%3E -> 500 error
- Payload reflected in: `<title>Error: Unexpected path: /api/search?q=%3Csvg%20onload%3Dalert(1)%3E</title>`

---

### 3. DOM-based XSS Potential
- **Endpoint**: /#/search?q=...
- **Status**: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED
- **Notes**: Angular application handles search parameter client-side. Payload in URL fragment reaches browser but sandbox prevents full exploitation. Real environment would need browser-based testing.

---

### 4. Unrestricted Product Access (IDOR - Low Severity)
- **Endpoint**: GET /api/Products/{id}
- **Status**: EXPECTED BEHAVIOR (public catalog)
- **Details**: All products accessible without authentication. This is by design for a shop application.

---

### 5. Review Access (IDOR - Low Severity)  
- **Endpoint**: GET /rest/products/{id}/reviews
- **Status**: EXPECTED BEHAVIOR (public reviews)
- **Details**: Product reviews visible without authentication. Normal e-commerce behavior.

---

## SEVERITY SUMMARY

| Finding | Severity | Confidence | CVSS |
|---------|----------|-----------|------|
| Unauthenticated Product Modification | CRITICAL | HIGH | 8.6 |
| Reflected XSS (Error Pages) | MEDIUM | HIGH | 5.3 |
| DOM XSS Potential | LOW | MEDIUM | 3.1 |

## REMEDIATION RECOMMENDATIONS

### For IDOR Vulnerability:
1. Implement authentication middleware on PUT /api/Products/{id}
2. Verify user role is 'admin' before allowing modifications
3. Add authorization checks before persisting data
4. Consider implementing audit logging for modifications

### For Reflected XSS:
1. HTML-escape all user input in error pages
2. Use parameterized error page templates
3. Consider implementing Content Security Policy (CSP)

# OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 - Complete Reconnaissance & Testing Roadmap

## Executive Summary

**Target**: http://host.docker.internal:3100  
**Application**: OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0  
**Type**: Deliberately vulnerable Angular SPA + Node.js/Express backend  
**Database**: SQL-based (likely SQLite or PostgreSQL)  
**Authentication**: JWT-based (RS256 algorithm)  
**Special Features**: LLM-powered chat, 2FA, Challenges/CTF system, Deluxe membership

## Complete Attack Surface Map

### Total Discovered Endpoints
- **REST API Endpoints**: 80+ unique paths
- **CRUD Operations**: Full CRUD on products, challenges, hints, memories, feedbacks
- **Authentication Routes**: 8+ (login, register, password reset, 2FA, etc.)
- **Admin Endpoints**: 3 (non-functional, return 500)
- **Special Endpoints**: GraphQL, WebSocket (Socket.io), Chat/LLM, Continue codes
- **Information Disclosure**: 6+ documentation/configuration endpoints

### Endpoint Categories

#### 1. Authentication & User Management (Critical Testing)
- **Registration**: `POST /api/Users` (201, no email verification)
- **Login**: `POST /rest/user/login` (JWT issued)
- **Whoami**: `GET /rest/user/whoami` (returns empty user object)
- **Password Reset**: `POST /rest/user/reset-password` (500 error - broken)
- **Security Questions**: `GET /api/SecurityQuestions` (14 public questions)
- **2FA Setup/Verify**: `POST /rest/2fa/setup`, `POST /rest/2fa/verify` (401)
- **2FA Disable**: `POST /rest/2fa/disable` (401)

**Vulnerability Potential**: JWT manipulation, brute force, authentication bypass

#### 2. Products & Shopping (Medium Testing)
- **List Products**: `GET /api/Products` (46 items, no auth)
- **Search Products**: `GET /rest/products/search?q=<query>` (potential NoSQL/SQLi)
- **Get Product**: `GET /api/Products/{id}` (sequential IDs = IDOR)
- **Quantities**: `GET /api/Quantitys` (56 items, stock & limits exposed)
- **Prices**: deluxePrice field available (business logic manipulation)

**Vulnerability Potential**: SQL/NoSQL injection, IDOR, price manipulation

#### 3. Cart & Orders (High Testing)
- **Basket Operations**: `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/basket/` (all 401)
- **Order Creation**: `POST /api/Orders` (500 error - broken)
- **Order History**: `GET /rest/order-history` (500 error - broken)
- **Track Order**: `GET /rest/track-order` (500 error - broken)

**Status**: Most endpoints currently non-functional, but structure known

#### 4. User Data & Payment (Critical Testing)
- **Addresses**: `GET/POST /api/Addresss` (401)
- **Cards**: `GET/POST /api/Cards` (401)
- **User Profile**: `GET /rest/user/authentication-details/{uid}` (401 with IDOR potential)
- **Payments**: Implied endpoints for payment processing

**Vulnerability Potential**: IDOR on user data, unauthorized address/card access

#### 5. Social & Feedback (High Testing)
- **Memories**: `GET /rest/memories` (10 items, UserIds exposed)
- **Feedbacks**: `GET /api/Feedbacks` (8 items, UserIds and partial emails exposed)
- **Reviews**: `GET/POST /api/Reviews` (500 error)
- **Complaints**: `GET/POST /api/Complaints` (401)
- **Compliments**: `GET/POST /api/Compliments` (500 error)

**Vulnerability Potential**: XSS in user content, information disclosure, IDOR

#### 6. Challenge System (High Testing for Understanding)
- **Challenges**: `GET /api/Challenges` (116 challenges, ~67KB)
- **Hints**: `GET /api/Hints` (397 hints, ~97KB)
- **Challenge Submit**: `POST /api/Challenges` (401)
- **Continue Codes**: `GET /rest/continue-code*` (3 endpoints, 200 OK)

**Value**: Understanding challenge objectives informs vulnerability discovery

#### 7. Configuration & Info Disclosure (Critical)
- **App Config**: `GET /rest/admin/application-configuration` (200, NO AUTH!)
- **Version**: `GET /rest/admin/application-version` (200)
- **.git Directory**: `GET /.git` (200 - exposed repository!)
- **Debug Endpoints**: `/debug`, `/metrics`, `/health`, `/config` all accessible
- **Documentation**: `/swagger`, `/api-docs`, `/openapi.json` all available

**Leakage**: OAuth credentials, feature flags, chatbot model info

#### 8. Special Features
- **Chat/LLM**: `POST /rest/chat` (Ollama Gemma4:e4b model)
- **Web3**: `GET /rest/web3` (500 error)
- **Deluxe Membership**: `GET /rest/deluxe-membership` (400, not eligible)
- **Languages**: `GET /rest/languages` (42 languages, i18n support)
- **Captcha**: `GET /rest/captcha` (math problems with answers!)
- **File Upload**: `POST /file/upload` (200, likely unrestricted)
- **File Download**: `GET /file/download` (200)

**Vulnerability Potential**: LLM prompt injection, unrestricted file upload, crypto logic

#### 9. WebSocket & Real-time
- **Socket.IO**: `/socket.io/` (400 Transport unknown error)

**Status**: WebSocket connection requires special handling

## Critical Findings

### 1. Information Disclosure Issues
- **Configuration Endpoint**: OAuth client ID, chatbot model, feature flags visible without authentication
- **Git Repository**: `.git` directory accessible (version history, credentials risk)
- **Password Hashes**: Visible inside JWT payloads as SHA1
- **User Data**: Memories and feedbacks expose UserIds and email addresses
- **Captcha Answers**: Captcha answers sent to client (`answer` field in response)

### 2. Authentication Issues
- **JWT Algorithm**: RS256 (but password hash visible in payload - massive leak!)
- **Admin Credentials**: Hardcoded `admin@juice-sh.op` / `admin123`
- **No Email Verification**: Registration succeeds without email confirmation
- **2FA Broken**: `/rest/2fa/*` endpoints return 500 errors on actual usage
- **Sequential IDs**: User IDs are sequential, enabling ID enumeration

### 3. Data Leakage Vectors
- **Password Hashes**: Exposed in JWT payload
- **2FA Secrets**: `totpSecret` visible in JWT if 2FA enabled
- **Stock Levels**: Quantities and per-user limits in `/api/Quantitys`
- **Personal Data**: User IDs, emails, captions in memories/feedbacks
- **Delivery Info**: Pricing and ETA for delivery methods

### 4. Business Logic Weaknesses
- **Price Fields**: Both `price` and `deluxePrice` exposed (possible manipulation)
- **LimitPerUser**: Purchase limits visible but likely not enforced in broken cart
- **Membership Status**: `deluxeToken` field in user object (manipulation potential)

### 5. File Upload
- `POST /file/upload` returns 200 with HTML homepage (unclear handling)
- `/file/download` exists but requires parameter testing
- Risk: Unrestricted file upload, path traversal, RCE

## Vulnerability Testing Priority Ranking

### Priority 1: CRITICAL - Test Immediately
1. **JWT Exploitation**
   - Decode JWT to extract password hashes and 2FA secrets
   - Test JWT tampering (modify role, user ID)
   - Test algorithm confusion (RS256 -> HS256 with public key)
   
2. **Information Disclosure**
   - Download `.git` repository and extract history/secrets
   - Extract OAuth credentials from configuration
   - Enumerate all leaked user data
   
3. **SQL/NoSQL Injection in Search**
   - `' OR '1'='1` returns all products (NoSQL injection indicator)
   - Test various SQL/NoSQL payloads in `/rest/products/search`
   
4. **IDOR on User Data**
   - Try to access other users' profiles via ID enumeration
   - `/rest/user/authentication-details/{uid}` with different UIDs
   - Memories and feedbacks with UserId parameter tampering

### Priority 2: HIGH - Critical Vulnerabilities
5. **File Upload Vulnerability**
   - Test unrestricted file upload to `/file/upload`
   - Attempt RCE via malicious files
   - Test path traversal in upload handling
   
6. **LLM Prompt Injection**
   - `POST /rest/chat` accepts user input to LLM
   - Test prompt injection to extract system prompts
   - Test jailbreak attempts on Gemma4 model
   
7. **Broken Authentication**
   - Brute force login endpoint (no rate limiting apparent)
   - Try default admin credentials
   - Test password reset without email verification

### Priority 3: MEDIUM - Business Logic & Chaining
8. **Price Manipulation**
   - Modify `price` or `deluxePrice` in requests
   - Exploit deluxe membership bypass
   
9. **Purchase Limit Bypass**
   - Attempt to exceed `limitPerUser` quantity
   - Chain with broken cart to bypass quantity checks
   
10. **Admin Panel Access**
    - Enumerate admin endpoints returning 500
    - Test privilege escalation from customer to admin
    - Try role manipulation in JWT

### Priority 4: MEDIUM - XSS & Content Injection
11. **Stored XSS in Comments**
    - Inject scripts in reviews, feedback, memories
    - Test HTML encoding bypass
    
12. **Reflected XSS in Search**
    - Search parameter might reflect in responses
    - Test DOM-based XSS via URL fragments

## Data Gathering for Other Agents

### Known Credentials
- Admin: `admin@juice-sh.op` / `admin123`
- JWT contains password hash in plaintext!

### Important IDs & Constants
- Product Count: 46 items (IDs: 1, 2, ..., 56 with gaps)
- Users: At least user ID 1 (admin) and 43+ (test user from recon)
- Challenges: 116 challenges
- Hints: 397 hints (3.4 hints per challenge average)
- Security Questions: 14 standard questions
- Languages: 42 available
- Delivery Options: 3
- Quantities: 56 stock records

### Response Patterns
```json
Success: {"status": "success", "data": [...]}
Error: {"status": "error", "message": "..."}
Auth Error: 401 with 972-byte error page
Not Found: 404
Server Error: 500 with stack trace
```

## Testing Breakdown for Specialized Agents

### 1. SQL/NoSQL Injection Agent
- Focus: `/rest/products/search`, login form
- Payload pool: SQLi, NoSQL operators, time-based blind
- Entry point: `q` parameter in search

### 2. IDOR/Authorization Agent
- Focus: All user-specific endpoints, ID parameters
- Test cases: Sequential ID enumeration, profile access, data access
- Endpoints: `/api/Users/`, `/api/Addresss/`, `/api/Cards/`, memories, feedbacks

### 3. JWT/Authentication Agent
- Focus: JWT manipulation, algorithm confusion, brute force
- Test: Token decoding, role manipulation, signature bypass
- Also test: 2FA bypass, password reset flow, account enumeration

### 4. File Upload/RCE Agent
- Focus: `/file/upload`, `/file/download` endpoints
- Test: File type bypass, path traversal, malicious content execution
- Technique: Various bypass techniques (double extension, null bytes, MIME type, magic bytes)

### 5. XSS Agent
- Focus: User-submitted content (reviews, feedback, memories, chat)
- Test: DOM XSS, stored XSS, filter bypass
- Payload vectors: Script tags, event handlers, SVG injection, HTML entities

### 6. Business Logic Agent
- Focus: Price manipulation, quantity limits, cart operations, deluxe membership
- Test: Parameter tampering on orders, price modification, limit bypass
- Chain with other vulns for maximum impact

### 7. Admin/Privilege Escalation Agent
- Focus: Admin endpoints (500 errors), role manipulation, service enumeration
- Test: JWT role modification, admin panel discovery, privilege escalation
- Technique: Horizontal and vertical escalation attempts

### 8. LLM/Prompt Injection Agent
- Focus: `/rest/chat` endpoint, Ollama Gemma4 model
- Test: Prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, system prompt extraction
- Technique: Standard LLM attack vectors, role confusion

## Summary Statistics

- **Total Unique Endpoints**: 80+
- **Public (No Auth)**: 35+
- **Requires Auth (401)**: 25+
- **Broken (500 Error)**: 15+
- **Vulnerable Data Exposure**: 10+ endpoints
- **Total Lines of Attack Surface**: Extremely large

## Next Steps for Agents

1. **Verification Phase**: Confirm all endpoints with direct requests
2. **Exploitation Phase**: Start with Priority 1 items (JWT, info disclosure, IDOR)
3. **Chaining Phase**: Combine findings for maximum impact
4. **Reporting Phase**: Document all confirmed vulnerabilities with PoCs
5. **Remediation Phase**: Suggest fixes for critical issues

---

**Reconnaissance Completed By**: Recon Agent  
**Completion Time**: ~2.5 hours  
**Confidence Level**: Very High (active endpoint verification, response analysis, configuration extraction)  
**Ready for**: Immediate exploitation testing
